community_list_entries.section: Resources / Benchmarks and Tasks / Personalized Task Evaluation
community_list_entries.name: MemDaily

phase1_classification.kind_reason: MemSim, a Bayesian simulator, generates the MemDaily dataset of daily-life user messages with QAs. It is used to benchmark memory mechanisms of LLM-based personal assistants on user-specific facts.
